materials.construction: Preserve recorded r7 local material vocabulary; remove 90-95% of source low-frequency signal with cyclic65px lowpass subtraction before bounded normalization. No synthetic geometry. A desert pavement of small ANGULAR FLAT GRAVEL fragments partially embedded in sand. Visible irregular broken chips approximately 1 to 3 percent of the image width, densely grouped in ragged connected clusters over about 45 percent of the surface; irregular open sand windows between clusters. The angular chips have simple muted flat gray-brown color fills with no bright edge, shadow, outline, bevel or raised-pebble appearance. Large enough that chip clusters and individual coarse pieces remain visible at 128 pixels, unlike fine-grain sand. Asymmetric all-over distribution, not circular islands or dots. Avoid cloudy noise; gravel-fragment topology is the defining cue.

normalization: Before existing normalization, luma becomes mean + (luma-lowpass65) + macroGain*(lowpass65-mean). Existing bounded±12 luma, chroma≤1,32px edge blend, radius6 split and residual exact reconstruction remain. B RMS4.5 gain.1; cantonment2.6/.08;pan1.5/.05. Macro attenuation percentages are pre-normalization coefficients; RMS normalization can rescale the remaining signal. Chroma uses original luma, preventing lowpass leakage.
